subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: Should beta releases be allowed to become beta-live when packaged-upgrade evidence is advisory and plugin npm/ClawHub convergence continues asynchronously after the two concrete regressions are fixed?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the release admission policy rather than only repairing a mechanical workflow failure; repository policy treats release, startup, and fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Fix regressions and approve beta-live policy
options.body: Restore reliable cached-upgrade execution and scorecard coverage, then accept detached ecosystem convergence for beta releases while stable and explicit-wait modes remain blocking.

options.title: Keep ecosystem evidence blocking for beta
options.body: Retain the new orchestration but require packaged-upgrade and plugin convergence before a beta is considered publishable.
